visualCharacteristics.purpose: Pull quote / testimonial with optional attribution
visualCharacteristics.description: default: centered navy italic quote (22-28px) on a light surface band with a bold grey attribution. banner: full-width dark slate #474c55 band with upright white ~26px centered text, typically no attribution. testimonial: centred upright quote (max ~800px) framed by large opening/closing quotation marks, attribution split into stacked uppercase lines (name / title / organization). testimonial-purple: full-width #811167 purple band, upright white ~26px centered quote (max ~600px) between white opening/closing quotation marks, attribution split into three centered uppercase white lines (name / title / organization).

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = quote (rich text); row 2 = attribution (plain text, optional; omitted when empty). Style select (classes) picks the option. testimonial: the attribution is split into lines on line breaks, or on commas when there are none. testimonial-purple: the attribution is split on line breaks only (no comma fallback, since organizations contain commas).

usage.description: Chemistry page (default testimonial); Remote Services and Diagnostics page (banner tagline); REMISOL Advance page (testimonial); DxA 5000 Fit page (testimonial-purple).

reuseGuidance: Use for a single standalone quote or tagline. Use banner for a full-width statement band without attribution. Use testimonial for a customer quote with a name / title / organization attribution. Use hero or default content for headings with CTAs. Use testimonial-purple for a customer quote on a full-width purple band.
